steps: The controller finds adjacent underutilized shards.
One target copies the other range and catches up changes.
Ownership is fenced so no update is lost during consolidation.

lesson.scenario: Two adjacent, underutilized customer-ID ranges are merged online while requests continue and ownership changes atomically.
entities: Resolves customer IDs using a versioned routing epoch
Receives the combined range before cutover
Copies, validates, fences, and publishes ownership

steps.title: Two small owners
steps.narration: The directory maps two adjacent ranges to separate shards; customer 742 resolves to Shard B.
steps.outcome: The merge candidate is adjacent and lightly loaded, but both sources still own writes.
steps.invariant: Every key has exactly one authoritative owner in routing epoch 41.

steps.title: Bulk copy
steps.narration: The controller takes consistent snapshots and streams both key ranges into the new combined shard.
steps.outcome: Foreground traffic remains on A and B while C receives a stable baseline.
steps.invariant: A snapshot alone is insufficient because writes continue after its LSN.

steps.title: Catch up and verify
steps.narration: Change streams replay post-snapshot writes until C matches both source logs and checksums.
action: replay to A@917, B@688; verify 2.0M rows
steps.outcome: C now contains the union of both ranges at the same log positions as its sources.
steps.invariant: Do not cut over until row counts, checksums, and change-stream lag meet the safety gate.

steps.title: Fence and cut over
steps.narration: Writes are briefly fenced, final deltas apply, and the directory atomically publishes one combined owner.
steps.outcome: New requests, including customer 742, resolve directly to C under epoch 42.
steps.invariant: The routing update must be atomic: overlapping or missing ownership would duplicate or lose writes.

steps.title: Retire old shards
steps.narration: After old-epoch requests drain and rollback time expires, A and B release their storage.
action: serve customer 742 from C under epoch 42
steps.outcome: One shard now owns the contiguous range, reducing per-shard overhead without downtime.
steps.invariant: Retire sources only after stale routers and in-flight epoch-41 requests can no longer write.
